initial_support.coverage: All6contexts and all7settings,42 context-setting rows. Every context training row/year retained at base fee in member table, plus all30 peryear summaries. Duplicate training rows across contexts are not independent initial evidence.
initial_support.full_target_only: At time0, x=(0,0,100), target w is the original own-fit target, rho is the unchanged selected release. Exact y=100*w/(1+c*(1-w_bill)); fee=100-sum(y), paid once.
initial_support.floor: F=(1-L)*100; B=max(F,100-rho*(100-F)); compare same y and same B with current-calendar year1 training support and all30-year joint training rows.
initial_support.inclusion: Calendar year1 is a subset of pooled joint support; min_pool<=min_calendar for the same y. Initial rejection is the stricter support condition of this fixed policy, not a statement that every portfolio must fail.
initial_support.members: Preserve trainingID/year and joint3asset real-gross row. Report peryear/fullpool minimum, all min ties, violating row counts, and bill realgross<1 counts. Never combine independent asset minima into a synthetic joint row.

directional_support.coverage: All funded main groups for all7settings and both cohorts; initialReview remains in complete path inventory but has zero account-period records.
directional_support.minimum: For each saved posttrade nominal holdings y and current CPI C, m_cal=min training_calendar_gross dot y/C and m_pool=min all_training_year_jointgross dot y/C. Actual next real wealth is saved physical endpoint.
directional_support.miss: actual_next < declared_support_directional_min -1e-12*current_real_wealth. This is a directional lower-bound failure for one saved allocation, not exact joint-support membership or a coverage probability.
directional_support.phases: Separate active ordinary primary-safe, current guard/mitigation, and prior-pending. Pending values are offline diagnostics, not forecasts made or constraints promised by the policy.
directional_support.risk: Keep original F and recompute normative budget for explanatory output; saved budget/certificate fields are compared only when gate_evaluated. Record original ever_breached/firstcrossing and firstguard, with complete original H and peak.
directional_support.bill_and_accounting: Report actual/training negative bill real gross. Verify exact one-step purchasing-power P&L both as -fee/Cpre + sum(y/Cpre*(greal-1)) and as (sum(y*r_nom)-fee-Vpre*pi)/Cnext. Perperiod accounting is not a unique MDD cause.

inflation_four_corners.match: For each of4policies, each originalID and each cohort, pair base and actual_inflation_plus_02 saved nominal paths/CPI. No outcome-based case filtering. Preserve NULL if a physical path is unavailable.
inflation_four_corners.peaks: Every corner starts at originaltime0 wealth100/CPI1 and recomputes full running peak and MDD. No reuse of suffix peaks or old MDD under a new numeraire.
inflation_four_corners.log_identity: log(R_SS/R_BB)=log(V_shift/V_base)-log(CPI_shift/CPI_base), exact at every endpoint. Nominal-path difference includes all decision/fee/holdings feedback, not only nominal-market effects.
inflation_four_corners.MDD: Report both telescopes: (MDD_BS-MDD_BB)+(MDD_SS-MDD_BS); (MDD_SB-MDD_BB)+(MDD_SS-MDD_SB). Interaction=MDD_SS-MDD_SB-MDD_BS+MDD_BB. No unique causal shares or percentage allocation.
inflation_four_corners.control: For same_target_annual and exact_thirds_annual the original nominal path/fee/postholding arrays should match across the actual-inflation-only shift. Test and retain any failure; do not silently repair.
inflation_four_corners.stress: pi_shift=pi_base+0.02 at every actual year, not greal minus0.02 or CPI multiplied by1.02. Own training support remains unchanged.
